about: What is known about each kind of shoal, whatever route it swims, measured in game for Trawling Plus. Kept by hand; tools/generate_routes.py copies it into routes.json.
format: fishableReach: how far from a shoal it can be fished from, in tiles along each axis, or 0 where not yet measured. bait: "any" where both fish offcuts and fine fish offcuts bait it, "fine" where only fine fish offcuts do.
